question_text: A 10 ft. long ladder leaning against a wall, touches the wall at a height of 8 ft. By what distance should the ladder be moved towards the wall so that its top touches the wall at 9.6 ft height ?
explanation: Initial base = √(10² - 8²) = 6 ft. New base = √(10² - 9.6²) = √(100 - 92.16) = √7.84 = 2.8 ft. The ladder moves 6 - 2.8 = 3.2 ft towards the wall[cite: 1].

question_text: If the average age of A, B and C is 22 years and the average age of B and C is 25 years, then the age of A after 9 years is :

question_text: Kamal buys an article for 20% less than its printed price and sells it for 20% more than the printed price. The percentage of gain on selling the article is
